fill_page_bytes_why: Input bytes one fill page reads. json_tree counts each JSON node as a row read, about one node per 17 bytes of a shared command's input (measured in workerd, 2026-10-22), so 400 KB is about 24,000 rows read, well inside the 67,584 rows a forget dependency page is admitted for.
fill_page_commands_why: Commands one fill page reads at most, whatever their size: about 3,000 subject rows written at most, inside the page's 16,896 rows written.
